testout=ns2['transform'](grid)
demo=[[9]*30 for _ in range(23)]
# 0 ring: rows 0-6, cols 9-15
def setring(g, r0,c0,h,w,color):
    for c in range(c0,c0+w): g[r0][c]=color; g[r0+h-1][c]=color
    for r in range(r0,r0+h): g[r][c0]=color; g[r][c0+w-1]=color
setring(demo,0,9,7,7,0)
for r in range(8,11):
    for c in range(3): demo[r][c]=4
# center 3 at (9,1) replaced expected 7
expected=[row[:] for row in demo]
for r in range(1,6):
    for c in range(10,15): expected[r][c]=7
expected[9][1]=7
actual=ns2['transform'](demo)
print('demo match',actual==expected,'dims',len(actual),set(map(len,actual)))
print('test result:')
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in testout))
